name: tokenomancer
description: See your Claude plan usage to the decimal. Tokenomancer reads Claude Code's live token logs and calibrates them against your official 5-hour, weekly, and Fable limits, so you know exactly where you stand between whole percentages.

tokenomancer.pollSeconds.description: How often to read the official numbers. Precision depends on this: 60 s gives about ±0.01–0.03 points, 30 s a little better, 300 s about ±0.05–0.1. Below 30 s risks rate limiting.

tokenomancer.statusBarBuckets.description: Limit buckets to show in the status bar, by endpoint key (e.g. five_hour, seven_day, seven_day_fable). Empty = 5-hour, weekly, and any Fable bucket. The full report lists available keys.

tokenomancer.decimals.description: Decimal places for estimated percentages. The hover shows the ± uncertainty, so you can see when the last digit is meaningful.

tokenomancer.officialRounding.description: How the official whole-number percentage is rounded. 'floor': 37 means 37.0–37.99. 'round': 37 means 36.5–37.49.

tokenomancer.claudeDir.description: Claude Code config folder. Empty = CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

tokenomancer.priceOverrides.description: Override per-model weights (USD per million tokens), keyed by a substring of the model id. Example: {"fable-5-1": {"input": 10, "output": 50, "cacheWrite5m": 12.5, "cacheWrite1h": 20, "cacheRead": 0.25}}

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
